Denoise pixel intensity matrix for a sample

Source: R/utils_processing.R
denoise.intensity.Rd

Applies spatial and correlation-based denoising to pixel-wise intensity data for a given sample.

Usage

denoise.intensity(metadata, intensity.matrix, sample, ncores = 1)

Arguments

metadata

Data frame containing pixel metadata, including 'Sample', 'pixel_id', 'x', and 'y'.

intensity.matrix

Data frame of intensity values (pixels as rows, features as columns).

sample

Character or factor specifying the sample/group to denoise.

ncores

Integer; number of cores for parallelisation (default 1).

Value

Data frame of denoised intensities for the selected sample (pixels x features).
